name: reva-security
description: Reva Security — enterprise governance for every OpenAI Codex CLI tool call and prompt

scripts.postbuild: codex plugin marketplace add . && codex plugin add reva-security@reva-plugins || echo "reva: Codex plugin not installed - see README Installing"
scripts.uninstall-plugin: codex plugin remove reva-security@reva-plugins && codex plugin marketplace remove reva-plugins
